dc:description: Analysis-ready, lifecycle-curated dataset derived from public Formula 1 session data accessed through the FastF1 Python library and Jolpica-F1. Three layers are produced: bronze (NDJSON, append-only, partitioned by session and driver), silver (DuckDB tables in main_silver schema, type-normalized, deduplicated on record_id via dbt staging models), and gold (DuckDB tables in main_gold schema; dimensions + facts + analytical aggregates in a star-schema layout, built by dbt marts). Includes lap timing, sector splits, tire compounds, pit stop indicators, race results, driver/team metadata, and weather snapshots for the full 2024 F1 season (24 rounds, 120 sessions). Sample-bundle deposit ships Parquet + CSV derivatives. Curated as the IS547 (Spring 2026) self-directed course project.
dc:publisher: Anand Marepalli (IS547, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, School of Information Sciences)

dcterms:provenance: Bronze NDJSON written by ingestion/producer.py and ingestion/backfill.py using FastF1; consumed/persisted by ingestion/{bronze,results,weather}_consumer.py. Silver and gold built by dbt-duckdb (project at dbt/) into a single-file DuckDB warehouse at data/warehouse.duckdb. Schedule reference data (dim_circuits, dim_races) sourced from version-controlled dbt seeds at dbt/seeds/, generated by ingestion/load_schedules.py. Full lineage in PROVENANCE.md and prov.jsonld; dbt's own manifest at dbt/target/manifest.json provides graph-level lineage post-build.
